baselineBehavior: Original example assumed native font-kerning support without checking, leaving unsupported environments without fallback or disabled controls.
changedBehavior: Added CSS @supports fallback and JS feature detection. In supported browsers, controls remain active; in stubbed unsupported environments, controls are disabled and informative fallback text is displayed.

unsupportedState.fallbackText: Notice: font-kerning is not supported in this browser environment.
